scope: The core Honmaru keep ensemble of Matsuyama Castle in Ehime as photographed in January 2009, including the three-story Main Keep, Small Keep, North and South Corner Turrets, Tammon connecting gallery and the Tenjin Turret as geographic context. Distant gate complexes and lower baileys are outside scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The castle operator identifies a combined tiered main keep complex built at the close of the Edo period.
The City of Matsuyama identifies the summit castle site as a nationally designated historic place.
